title: sesamum trilobum
intro: Sesamum trilobum, commonly known as White sesame, is a plant species within the genus Sesamum, belonging to the family Pedaliaceae. This plant is known for its seeds, which have been used in traditional medicine for their numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Sesamum trilobum are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesamin, sesamolin, and other lignans, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
